'''The western wall''' of [[Livien Magnus]] was a protective enclosure around the west side of [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]. It was destroyed by [[Imperial commando (Sith Empire)|Imperial commandos]] during the [[Battle of Ord Radama]] in [[3660 BBY]].<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side" />
